name: lob-program-fk-normalization
description: FK-normalize ProgramName and LineOfBusiness into master-table foreign keys across the Finnova backend, expose GET master APIs, and update the Finnova-UI dropdowns to source from them. Two repos, schema-destructive, verify efficiently (build once, targeted tests at the end).

steps.prompt:
Plan a heavy, two-repo FK-normalization. Explore BOTH repos and write an implementation-ordered plan to d:\Projects\Finnova\Finnova-API\.agents\tasks\lob-program-fk\plan.md. Do NOT change code. Repos (work directly on these branches, no worktrees, never commit): backend d:\Projects\Finnova\Finnova-API branch feature/FINNOVA-10-user-management (Finnova.Backend.slnx, net10.0); frontend D:\Projects\Finnova\Finnova-UI branch main (React18+TS+MUI+Vite, Vitest+RTL).

LOCKED DECISIONS: (1) FULL FK normalization, not validation-only. (2) New master table lines_of_business, entity LineOfBusiness with business columns Id(Guid PK), LOB_Name(string), LOB_Description(string) PLUS housekeeping IsActive(bool), CreatedAt, UpdatedAt (match other masters). Seed from the hardcoded Finnova.Service/UserManagement/Internal/LineOfBusinessCatalog.cs; preserve the 'LOB must be linked to role codes' validation rule against seeded data. (3) programs master already exists (table programs, entity ScreenProgram, 9 seeded rows) — reuse, do NOT recreate. (4) Wire key = Id (Guid); APIs expose Id, UI sends Id, labels from LOB_Name / ScreenProgram.DisplayName. (5) Add GET master APIs: active LOBs {id,lobName,lobDescription} and active programs {id,programName,displayName}, on the SystemAdminService host alongside the existing /api/user/ref/* endpoints (UserManagementController); REPLACE the existing /api/user/ref/lines-of-business data source (currently the hardcoded catalog) to read lines_of_business; add a programs ref GET.

NORMALIZE (string -> Guid FK): UserAccessAssignment.LineOfBusiness->LineOfBusinessId (FK lines_of_business) and .ProgramName->ProgramId (FK programs); UserBranchAssociation.LineOfBusiness->LineOfBusinessId; FunctionalGroupFunction.ProgramName->ProgramId. KEEP RoleCenterName and RoleCode. RoleCode = RoleCenterName + ProgramName via RoleCodeBuilder — RoleCode output MUST stay identical, so resolve ProgramId -> ScreenProgram.ProgramName (the stable key, NOT DisplayName) and feed that to RoleCodeBuilder. Confirm which string RoleCodeBuilder used today and preserve it.

REWORK handlers/contracts to carry Ids: SaveUserAccess (command/validator/handler) incl. CopyProfileRequest.SourceLineOfBusiness->SourceLineOfBusinessId; GetUserAccess (query/handler) LineOfBusiness->LineOfBusinessId and AccessRightRow.ProgramName->ProgramId (prefer also returning display names so UI renders labels without extra lookups); CreateFunctionalGroup handler; UserManagementRepository ReplaceAccessAsync/GetAccessAsync filters by Id; add repo methods to list active LOBs/programs and lookups by Id. Update Finnova.Models/Contracts/UserManagement/* (UserAccessResponse, SaveUserAccessRequest, AccessRightRow, CopyProfileRequest, FunctionalGroupFunctionResponse). PIN the EXACT final wire shapes (access contracts + the two ref endpoints, camelCase) in the plan for the frontend step.

EF: new LineOfBusinessConfiguration (ToTable lines_of_business, HasData seed, deterministic GUIDs + 2024-01-01 UTC); DbSet on FinnovaDbContext; FK config + OnDelete Restrict in the three satellite configs; update indexes that referenced the old string columns. ONE migration AddLineOfBusinessAndFkNormalization (create+seed lines_of_business, add FK columns, DROP old string columns, recreate indexes). The three satellite tables hold NO real rows (verify no HasData into them), so no data backfill needed. Migration must NOT be applied (the orchestrator applies after review).

UI (src/components/userManagement/* and src/services/userManagement.*): add LOB + Programs master services/models (interface/mock/real/toggle, mirror lookup/location, update barrels); LOB dropdown binds Id (label lobName); access-rights program refs use ProgramId (label displayName); update userManagement model/service request/response + WizardContext/draft + save payload to Ids matching the pinned backend contracts (camelCase lineOfBusinessId, programId). Keep useScreenPermissions gating intact.

EFFICIENCY (user-mandated): plan for verify ONCE — backend build once + a TARGETED test slice (filter UserManagement|GetMyPermissions|Auth), frontend npm run build once + npm test -- --run once (or filtered to touched specs). No repeated full-suite runs. Keep the loop lean (max 3). Author FEAT artifacts if you decompose along the repo boundary, but preserve the loop's stop contract (review.json verdict==APPROVED).

Implement the FK-normalization per d:\Projects\Finnova\Finnova-API\.agents\tasks\lob-program-fk\plan.md. On the FIRST iteration implement the whole change; on later iterations read .agents\tasks\lob-program-fk\review.json + review.md and fix every HIGH/MEDIUM finding only. Work DIRECTLY on branch feature/FINNOVA-10-user-management (backend, d:\Projects\Finnova\Finnova-API) and branch main (frontend, D:\Projects\Finnova\Finnova-UI). NEVER commit in either repo. Use absolute paths; step cwd is the backend workspace.

Scope exactly as the plan pins it: new LineOfBusiness entity + lines_of_business table + seed from LineOfBusinessCatalog; replace string columns with Guid FKs (UserAccessAssignment.LineOfBusinessId/ProgramId, UserBranchAssociation.LineOfBusinessId, FunctionalGroupFunction.ProgramId); keep RoleCode output identical by resolving ProgramId->ScreenProgram.ProgramName for RoleCodeBuilder; rework SaveUserAccess/GetUserAccess/CopyProfile/CreateFunctionalGroup/repository/contracts to Ids; replace the /api/user/ref/lines-of-business data source with the table and add a programs ref GET returning active programs; UI dropdowns source from the new master APIs and send Ids with field-name (camelCase) parity to the backend contracts; keep useScreenPermissions gating intact. Generate ONE migration AddLineOfBusinessAndFkNormalization (dotnet ef migrations add AddLineOfBusinessAndFkNormalization --project Finnova.Repository/Finnova.Repository.csproj --startup-project Finnova.SystemAdminService/Finnova.SystemAdminService.csproj) and DO NOT run database update.

EFFICIENT VERIFICATION (user-mandated — do this ONCE at the end, not each loop and not full suites): backend `dotnet build Finnova.Backend.slnx` (0 errors) then a targeted slice `dotnet test Finnova.Tests/Finnova.Tests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~UserManagement|FullyQualifiedName~GetMyPermissions|FullyQualifiedName~Auth"`; frontend `npm run build` then `npm test -- --run` (filtered to touched specs is fine). If a running host locks bin DLLs (MSB3027), note it. Record a concise verification.md with the exact commands run and their pass/fail results for the reviewer to read (the reviewer will NOT re-run suites). Signal success via send_message when done.

Review the FK-normalization across BOTH repos (backend d:\Projects\Finnova\Finnova-API @ feature/FINNOVA-10-user-management, frontend D:\Projects\Finnova\Finnova-UI @ main) using the working-tree diffs and the implementer's verification.md. Do NOT re-run build/test suites — rely on the recorded evidence. Check: (a) FK normalization correct — the old string columns LineOfBusiness/ProgramName are dropped, Guid FK columns + relationships + indexes are correct, and RoleCode output is unchanged (resolved via ScreenProgram.ProgramName, not DisplayName); (b) lines_of_business table + seed correct, and BOTH ref GET APIs correct with the existing lines-of-business endpoint no longer using the hardcoded LineOfBusinessCatalog; (c) SaveUserAccess/GetUserAccess/CopyProfile/CreateFunctionalGroup/repository use Ids and the 'LOB must be linked to role codes' rule still holds; (d) UI dropdowns source from the APIs and send Ids with exact camelCase field-name parity to the backend contracts; (e) recorded evidence shows backend build + targeted tests green and frontend build + touched specs green; (f) the migration AddLineOfBusinessAndFkNormalization exists and was NOT applied. Write review.md (findings) then the gate file d:\Projects\Finnova\Finnova-API\.agents\tasks\lob-program-fk\review.json with {"verdict":"APPROVED"} when there are no HIGH/MEDIUM findings, otherwise {"verdict":"CHANGES_REQUESTED"} with the findings in review.md for the implementer to fix. Always send_message with severity success summarizing the verdict.

Finalization (no commits — committing is the user's). Confirm the working-tree state of both repos: backend d:\Projects\Finnova\Finnova-API (feature/FINNOVA-10-user-management) and frontend D:\Projects\Finnova\Finnova-UI (main). Produce a concise final report: files changed per repo; the migration name AddLineOfBusinessAndFkNormalization and that it is generated but NOT applied; the exact final wire shapes for the two ref endpoints (LOB {id,lobName,lobDescription}; programs {id,programName,displayName}) and the reworked access contracts (SaveUserAccessRequest, UserAccessResponse, AccessRightRow, CopyProfileRequest, FunctionalGroupFunctionResponse); and explicit confirmation that nothing was committed in either repo. Remind the orchestrator to apply the migration with `dotnet ef database update --project Finnova.Repository/Finnova.Repository.csproj --startup-project Finnova.SystemAdminService/Finnova.SystemAdminService.csproj` after review. send_message the report with severity success.
